shared_elements: upright slab/stele carved in low relief
row of repeated small motifs along the upper zone
larger figures occupying the main lower field
small isolated signs/objects filling space between figures
justification: Both are upright relief-carved slabs organised into horizontal registers, with a band of repeated small motifs above and larger profile figures below, plus small filler signs — a loosely comparable compositional scheme. But the depicted content is wholly different: A shows animals (quadrupeds, birds, a serpentine/plant form) rendered in bold rounded relief, while B shows two human figures in a symmetrical facing arrangement with a central axis, arched frame and rows of script-like signs, drawn in fine linear convention.
